import html # Define the HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Content
{user_content}
""" def create_html_output(input_content: str) -> str: """ Produce a complete HTML string by injecting escaped user content into the predefined template. Parameters: input_content (str): The dynamic content supplied by the user. Returns: str: A safe HTML string with the user's content properly escaped. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS or markup injection. safe_content = html.escape(input_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
